verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents experiment rules on feature flags that hash users into one of several variations (docs-33, docs-29). Results are computed against warehouse-defined metrics (docs-9, docs-68) using Bayesian or Frequentist engines, and a 'Chance to Win' above 95% highlights the clear winner (docs-30, docs-48, gh-2). A community user also reports getting A/B tests running in their frontend within hours (comm-4). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multivariate experiments with more than two variations (only implied by 'one of your experiment variations' and multi-arm bandits), and independent hands-on corroboration of reading winners from the results UI.
